**Apple's FY2024 gross margin**

For the fiscal year ended September 28, 2024, Apple reported a gross margin of **$180,683 million** [DOC-1], derived from total net sales of $391,035 million less cost of sales of $210,352 million [DOC-1].

Supporting context:
- Gross margin percentage: $180,683 ÷ $391,035 = **46.2%** [DOC-1]
- Prior-year comparative (FY ended September 30, 2023): gross margin of $169,148 million on net sales of $383,285 million, or 44.1% [DOC-1] — an increase of $11,535 million (+6.8%) year over year.

Comparability note: the question asks only about FY2024 as reported in Apple's own FY2024 10-K, so there is no entity or accounting-basis mismatch. If the year-over-year figures above are used, note that the two periods are not of identical length — FY2024 ended September 28, 2024 and FY2023 ended September 30, 2023 [DOC-1] — so the growth comparison spans fiscal years of differing week counts; the excerpt does not disclose the number of weeks in each period.

ANSWER: $180,683 million (46.2% of net sales) for fiscal year ended September 28, 2024
